children: IOI Corp.'s upstream earnings could improve in FY 2027, driven by higher crude palm oil prices and output, RHB IB analyst Hoe Lee Leng says in a note. Refinery margins are expected to remain challenging, while oleochemical margins should stay relatively robust, supported by the Middle East conflict and front-loading ahead of EU deforestation regulations, she says. The specialty fats segment should benefit from the completed New Orleans plant expansion and new Amsterdam complex from 2H FY 2027, partly offset by lower cocoa butter-equivalent margins, she adds. RHB raises IOI's target price to 5.45 ringgit from 5.05 ringgit, while maintaining a buy rating on the stock. Shares are 0.6% higher at 4.71 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
